name: Luoding
assessment: Local registry custody is evidenced by official Luoding municipal and Natural Resources Bureau material. No public parcel viewer/API or safe anonymous ID-plus-polygon response was verified, so no sample GeoJSON was retained and runtime remains held.
queryAndRequestOutcome: Separate English and Chinese first-party discovery queries found official local registration, cadastral-survey, and policy pages. Direct TLS-verified curl to one official portal route failed before HTTP because the certificate was expired; no bypass was attempted. No public parcel endpoint was invented or treated as successful.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native public parcel ID if source-proven

qualification.reason: Registry custody is documented, but no live feature schema, CRS, native parcel identity, or safe parcel geometry was retrieved.

scopeLimits: Exact WUP point preserved; no coordinate shift.
No zero-hit, map-extent miss, timeout, login wall, certificate failure, or unusable UI was treated as citywide absence.
Local registry custodian evidence does not substitute for parcel-feature evidence.
No raw source-specific attribute set retained.
No GeoJSON sample retained; maximum allowed would have been three full parcel polygons.
uncertainty: A different official Guangdong or Luoding viewer route may expose safe geometry later. This packet is research evidence only and is not source integration/admission.
